name: datamitsu-toolkit
description: Format files with your datamitsu config, via the datamitsu language server.

enumDescriptions: Use a datamitsu found on PATH; if none, download the version pinned to this extension build.
Use a datamitsu found on PATH only; error if none is found.
Always use the version pinned to this extension build (ignore PATH).
datamitsu.binaryMode.description: How to locate the datamitsu binary that runs the language server.

datamitsu.format.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Watchdog for format-on-save, in milliseconds: once it has elapsed, no further group of fix tools starts. A running tool is never stopped, and tool downloads do not count. `0` disables it. Unset, the language server uses `DATAMITSU_LSP_FORMAT_TIMEOUT_MS` or its default, `15000`.

datamitsu.format.tools.markdownDescription: Per-tool override for format-on-save, keyed by tool name in the datamitsu config. `false` keeps a tool out of the editor; `true` runs a project-wide tool on save even when `#datamitsu.format.widenTo#` is `target` or its operation declares no `globs`, up to the project's own `execution.widenTo`. Neither brings in a repository-wide tool or an operation the config marks `lsp: false`.

enumDescriptions: Only file-level fix tools run on save.
File-level fix tools, plus project-wide fix tools that declare globs, over the saved file's project.
datamitsu.format.widenTo.markdownDescription: How far format-on-save reaches beyond the saved file. Project-wide tools never go beyond the project's own `execution.widenTo`, and one whose operation declares no `globs` runs only when `#datamitsu.format.tools#` opts it in. Repository-wide tools never run on save. Unset, the language server uses `DATAMITSU_LSP_FORMAT_WIDEN_TO` or its default, `unit`.

datamitsu.path.description: Explicit path to the datamitsu binary. Overrides datamitsu.binaryMode when set.

datamitsu.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and the datamitsu language server.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Datamitsu evaluates datamitsu.config.{js,mjs,ts} as code and runs workspace-configured tools, so it requires a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Datamitsu spawns a native binary and needs direct local filesystem access; it cannot operate on a virtual filesystem.
